categories.main_business_segments: Entegris operates through three primary business segments: Specialty Chemicals and Engineered Materials (SCEM), Microcontamination Control (MC), and Advanced Materials Handling (AMH). SCEM provides high-performance process chemistries, gases, and materials; MC offers filtration and purification solutions for critical liquid chemistries and gases; and AMH develops solutions for monitoring, protecting, transporting, and delivering critical materials and substrates, primarily for the semiconductor industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced material science, high-purity chemical synthesis, specialty coatings, membrane filtration, and engineered polymer processing. Manufacturing methods include cleanroom production, advanced membrane modification, chemical distillation and purification, graphite synthesis, and automated quality and supply chain management systems. Entegris emphasizes contamination control, precision delivery systems, and integrated solutions across its segments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Entegris primarily serves logic and memory semiconductor device manufacturers, semiconductor equipment makers, gas and chemical manufacturing companies, and wafer growers. Additional markets include flat panel display manufacturers, hard disk drive component makers, solar, life sciences, aerospace, and biomedical device manufacturers. The company’s top ten customers account for about 43% of net sales, with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company and Samsung Electronics as significant customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Entegris has a global footprint, with approximately 77% of net sales generated outside the United States. Key regions include North America, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The company operates manufacturing, R&D, and support facilities in the US, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, China, and Singapore, with a significant new facility under construction in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Entegris operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier within the semiconductor and high-technology manufacturing supply chain. It provides mission-critical materials, filtration, purification, and handling solutions that are integrated into customers’ manufacturing processes, supporting both consumable and capital equipment needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy centers on technology leadership, customer collaboration, operational excellence, and expansion into adjacent markets. R&D is focused on advanced technology nodes, materials purity, contamination control, and integrated solutions for next-generation semiconductor manufacturing. Entegris invests heavily in innovation, with R&D spending at 7.3% of net sales, and pursues strategic acquisitions to broaden its technology and product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Entegris generates revenue primarily through the sale of consumable products (such as specialty chemicals, filters, and handling solutions) and, to a lesser extent, capital equipment. Approximately 69% of revenue is recurring or unit-driven, tied to products consumed in semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company also earns revenue from service, licensing, and, in some cases, long-term supply agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Entegris faces competition from both large multinational and regional companies, including Pall Corporation (Danaher), Shin-Etsu Polymer, Gemu Valves, Tokyo Keiso, Mersen, Merck KGaA (EMD Performance Materials), DuPont, Air Liquide, Praxair (Linde), Donaldson, and Parker Hannifin. While no single competitor matches Entegris’ full breadth of offerings, many compete in specific product areas. Entegris is positioned as a technology leader with a broad, integrated portfolio and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Entegris reported net sales of $2.3 billion, up 24% from the prior year, with a gross margin of 46.1% and net income of $409 million. The company has demonstrated strong growth, driven by increased semiconductor demand and strategic acquisitions. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 30.4%, and the company maintains a robust balance sheet with significant cash flow from operations and ongoing investments in capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Entegris differentiates itself through its comprehensive, high-purity materials and contamination control solutions, deep applications expertise, and ability to deliver integrated, co-optimized products across the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Its broad product portfolio, customer intimacy, and focus on innovation and quality provide high switching costs for customers and support superior manufacturing yields, device performance, and reliability.
